evidence: The phase-purity, chemical composition, thickness, topography, and orientation of the films were characterized by various standard methods. X-Ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were performed... The thickness of the films grown on Si(100) and soda-lime-glass substrates was measured with X-ray reflectivity... The composition of the films was determined by X-ray fluorescence (XRF) measurements... Atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurements were performed... Selected films were analyzed with transmission FT-IR spectroscopy...
